Private tuition helps you improve your Italian with a qualified teacher. It suits students who want to reach their goals in a short time, with flexible hours.

What you can study

General Italian

All levels. General Italian, diction, preparation for the CILS and Roma Tre certification exams.

Thematic courses

Levels B1–C2. Literature, theology and philosophy, cinema, art history, cities of art.

The fee includes
  • Each set of 10 lessons: 9 lessons of general Italian or a thematic course and 1 pronunciation lesson
  • Self-study activities, with feedback from the teacher
  • Online placement test and interview before the course starts
  • Certificate of attendance
  • Certificate of evaluation based on the European framework, with credits
  • Preparation for the CILS and Roma Tre certification exams
  • Academy card: discounts in restaurants and shops, free entry to 4 museums in Assisi
  • Free wi-fi
